description: Bassin de la Leyre : Résultats de la première année du suivi de la mesure OLAE "entretien de fossés" sur le bassin versant de la Leyre is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gerea.fr. Study on the Leyre catchment area relating to the maintenance of ditches; paper document only. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Leyre basin: Results of the first year of monitoring of the OLAE measure "maintenance of ditches" in the Leyre catchment" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include fossés, inspire, leyre, entretien. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
